title: Rapid Detection of SARS-CoV-2 Using CRISPR Diagnostics
author: Mammoth Biosciences
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfhcjj2w
materials: Extract patient RNA following CDC recommendations .

steps.title: Prepare LbCas12a RNP complexes
steps.instruction: Generate separate LbCas12a‑gRNA ribonucleoprotein complexes for N‑gene, E‑gene, and RNase P for each sample.

substeps.instruction: On ice, combine LbCas12a protein with the N‑gene gRNA, E‑gene gRNA, and RNase P gRNA in separate tubes (one complex per gRNA per sample).
Incubate each mixture at 37 °C for 30 minutes to form RNP complexes.
Add reporter substrate to each tube to reach a final concentration of 500 nM.
Place the completed RNP‑reporter reactions on ice (4 °C); they remain stable for at least 24 hours.

steps.title: Set up RT‑LAMP amplifications
steps.instruction: Prepare three RT‑LAMP reactions per sample, one for each target gene.

substeps.instruction: On ice, assemble RT‑LAMP master mixes using the primer sets for N‑gene, E‑gene, and RNase P.
Incubate the reactions at 62 °C for 30 minutes.
When opening amplification tubes, take precautions to avoid amplicon contamination.

steps.title: Assemble detection mixtures
steps.instruction: Combine RT‑LAMP products with the corresponding RNP complexes and buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 µL of each RT‑LAMP product to the matching 18 µL LbCas12a RNP complex (same gRNA).
Add 80 µL of 1× NEBuffer 2.1 to each mixture.

steps.title: Incubate Cas12a cleavage reaction
steps.instruction: Allow the assembled mixtures to cleave the reporter.

steps.title: Lateral‑flow readout
steps.instruction: Detect reporter cleavage using a lateral flow strip.

substeps.instruction: Insert a Milenia HybriDetect 1 (TwistDx) lateral flow strip directly into each reaction tube.
Let the strip develop at room temperature for 2 minutes.
Interpret the result: the line nearest the sample pad is the control line, the line farthest is the test line; complete reporter cleavage may eliminate the control line.
